requirements.brief: Default repeater, reused by Riftshot. Submit a static handheld through the existing weapon profile. A coordinated two-gun set is planned; the current explicit item selection stays selected in both modes.

requirements.name: Wildspark launcher
requirements.brief: The second gun in the class-default Q switch. Individual static handheld submission is supported. Mode-specific cosmetic set approval and equipment are future work; this is not a third Q weapon.

requirements.name: Rocket-mode basic attack body
